annotations.title: Request a now check (is it still true right now?)

description: Request that a human verifies whether a fact is true at this moment (open now, in stock, price, event happening) and timestamps the answer with evidence. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

claim.description: The statement to check, e.g. 'Café X at Y is open today until 18:00'.

deadline.description: Optional: by when you need the answer.

location.description: Optional: address or place if relevant.
